title: Yellowed Flaky Brazilian Tripe Fritters
description: A traditional Brazilian dish featuring tripe, these fritters are mustardy, flaky, and perfect for a weeknight meal. They are also sugar-free-friendly, making them a great option for those with dietary restrictions.

ingredients.name: tripe
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into small pieces

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the flour, mustard, salt, and pepper.
Add the tripe to the bowl and toss to coat with the flour mixture.
In a separate bowl, beat the eggs and add to the tripe mixture, stirring until everything is well combined.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the tripe mixture into the hot oil.
Fry the fritters for 3-4 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fritters from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fritters hot and enjoy.
